item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. You've built real structure into today: a morning perspective practice, a stress check-in, a check on projecting or mind-reading, and a moment to ask if what you're doing supports the life you want. That's the whole game — catching the story you're telling yourself before it runs you. Action: when that mind-reading check comes up this afternoon, actually answer it, out loud, honestly.
